rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education providers recognized by the Board
rules.alternatives: Thirty contact hours is one of four options; any one during the licensure period also works: keeping a national certification from a Board-recognized body, completing a Board-recognized academic program in nursing or a related field, or employer certification of competency and hours practiced on the Board form.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; evidence must be kept at least 4 years and produced within 5 business days of request, otherwise the license is temporarily suspended.

topics.who: Licensed before 2026: first by Jan 1, 2028; licensed from 2026: within 2 years of licensure. Board-approved provider only.

rules.notes: Biennial renewal under the Nurse Practice Act. The Board's site (llr.sc.gov) could not be reached, so renewal dates, fee and online link are not recorded here.
